measurement.browser_action_ms: daemon dispatch wall time excluding batch wrappers; includes browser waits and bookkeeping
measurement.browser_driver_ms: sum of timed driver calls (including waits and summaries); overlapping cancellation spans may exceed task wall time
measurement.response_bytes: complete newline-terminated daemon response envelopes, UTF-8
measurement.agent_tools_and_model_metrics: unmeasured; deterministic client replay, not a real Agent
